Subject: Initial ask: MAP, evaluation scope + private offer on GCP

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. RetailCo is lining up an evaluation of embedding search and multitenant inference across a 10-app pilot. Procurement asked me to get a mutual action plan (MAP) and a clear path to a GCP private offer reflecting staged credits and commit triggers — we need these for internal approval.

High-level ask:
- A 4–6 week evaluation plan with success criteria (latency, cost per query, indexing throughput).
- A GCP private offer with trial credits tied to MAP milestones and an initial committed spend option if evaluation meets targets.
- Pricing steps / discount tiers that kick in at commit and at ramp milestones.

Can you send a draft MAP + private offer outline and confirm what documentation (SOC2, data flow diagrams) you can provide for procurement?

Best,
Alex

Hi Alex — appreciate the clear brief. Attaching a proposed MAP (RetailCo_MAP_v1.pdf) and a GCP private offer outline. Summary of the proposal below so you can circulate with procurement:

Proposed MAP (4 weeks, accelerated track)
- Week 0 (kickoff): Provision GCP private offer + 60k trial credits preloaded; technical onboarding with Redwood infra team; shared eval playbook.
- Week 1–2 (integration): Connector + baseline dataset ingest; smoke tests for latency/throughput.
- Week 3 (stress & edge cases): Production-ish load tests, KV cache tuning, quantization profile validation.
- Week 4 (acceptance): Run acceptance suite; if thresholds met, trigger private-offer commit options.

Acceptance criteria (examples)
- 99th percentile latency < 220ms for typical 2k token requests
- Embedding recall @ 95% of current baseline on canonical test set
- Cost per 1k tokens < $X after caching and batching optimizations

GCP private offer: staged credit + commit ladder
- Trial: 60k credits (applied automatically once private offer is accepted). Credits expire 60 days after activation.
- Option A (accelerated commit): 3-month minimum commit of $90k (triggers 15% off list) — immediate additional 40k credit top-up when commit executes.
- Option B (standard ramp): No upfront commit; upon successful acceptance, convert to a 6-month staged commit with 10% discount at $150k total committed spend, and additional discounts at 12-month extension.
- Ramp triggers: discounts step up at 3x and 10x consumption milestones; bandwidth-burst credits available for seasonal spikes (pre-agreed caps).

Documentation and security
- We can provide SOC 2 Type II report and network flow diagrams; redacted audit logs and key management notes available under NDA.

Next steps
1) I uploaded the MAP draft and private-offer sketch (links below).
2) If procurement wants different credit cadence (e.g., monthly instead of 60-day expiry), we can adjust; the accelerated commit reduces the credit expiry window.
3) Proposed 30-minute sync Friday to finalize numbers and legal touchpoints.

Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeF_MAP_draft
Marketplace preview: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/private/offers/retailco-offer-id

Attachments: RetailCo_MAP_v1.pdf

Regards,
